Item 8.01. Other Events.

On January 29, 2024, Liaoning Shuiyun Qinghe Rice Industry Co., Ltd. (the "Company" ) has decided to propose the acquisition of the second target company, Beijing Shixiaobao Smart  Technology Co., Ltd, a company deeply involved in the field of AI robotics. The Company is currently intensively conducting audits and due diligence of this acquisition. This move  aims to further enhance the Company's business scale and comprehensive strength.

Additionally, the Company has made breakthrough progress in the field of AI robots. The new generation of AI robots will better serve households and communities, providing users with  smarter and more convenient services.

Meanwhile, the Company is actively exploring domestic and international markets. Currently, the Company's marketing team is conducting practical inspections of overseas channels with  a view to further expanding the market coverage and enhancing the company's global competitiveness.
